info.title: mt5 manager rest
info.description:
You can check test our MT5 Manager RESTfull API simply in browser. To connect to mt5 namager account you need to call method '/Connect'. It returns token that you need to use in further requests as 'id' parameter.

You can use your own account.

get.description: Returns Token that you need to use as "id" parameter for further reqests

parameters.description: Host - ip adddress or dns name with or without port number. Example: mt4-demo.roboforex.com

Order profit updates. Call SubscribeOrderProfitInterval to subscibe.
Order profit updates with one message. Call SubscribeOrderProfitInterval to subscibe.

Deleted trades only. Fires when a position is deleted (closed or removed by admin, UpdateAction=Delete)
or when all positions of a login are cleaned (UpdateAction=Clean).
Payload is the same MT4-format trade record as /OnPositionUpdateMT4Format.
Note: deletion of history deals (e.g. DealDeleteBatch) is reported via /OnDealUpdate with Action=Delete.

post.summary: Gets the deal history for multiple trading accounts (logins) within the specified time period.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Session token returned by the `Connect` method. Required.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description:
Start of the time range in ISO format (`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss`).
Example: `2023-07-04T00:00:00`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description:
End of the time range in ISO format (`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss`).
Example: `2023-07-05T00:00:00`.

get.summary:
Paginated variant of 'OpenedOrders' with an optional open-time date filter.
Login search works the same way as in 'OpenedOrders': null logins - all open orders.
Data is fetched live on every call (open orders change constantly), only sliced for the requested page.

get.summary:
Paginated variant of 'OrderHistory' (per-login position history) with the same date filter.
The full result set is cached (sliding TTL), so subsequent pages of the same query do not re-query the server.

get.summary: Accounts details. If logins not specifed reutns details for all accoungts.

Paginated variant of 'UserDetailsMany' with an optional registration-date filter.
Login search works the same way as in 'UserDetailsMany': if logins are not specified, returns all accounts.
The full result set is cached (sliding TTL), so subsequent pages of the same query do not re-query the server.
Update user. Only specified fields are updated. Use enableRights/disableRights to toggle individual rights without affecting others.

parameters.name: enableRights
parameters.description: Comma-separated right names to enable (OR into existing). Values: enabled,password,trade_disabled,investor,confirmed,trailing,expert,reports,readonly,reset_pass,otp_enabled,sponsored_hosting,api_enabled,push_notification

parameters.name: disableRights
parameters.description: Comma-separated right names to disable (remove from existing). Same values as enableRights.

ClientOrderPaginatedResult.description:
Generic pagination envelope. Mirrors the mt4-manager-rest implementation
so both APIs expose the same paging contract.

isConnected.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the terminal is currently connected.

connectTimeUTC.description: Gets or sets the UTC timestamp of the most recent successful connection to the server.

lastQuoteTimeUTC.description: Gets or sets the UTC timestamp of the last received market quote from the server.

ConnectionStatus.description:
Represents the connection status of a trading terminal,
including connectivity state and key timestamps.

OrderSort.description: How to sort order history orders

SessionState.description: True or false for current symbol for now

serverTime.description: Tick time in broker SERVER time.

convRates.description: Convertation rates from profit currency to group deposit currency

magic.description: Special value used by client experts

gwOpenPrice.description: Gateway order price deviation (pips) from order open price

gwClosePrice.description: Gateway order price deviation (pips) from order close price

marginRate.description: Margin convertation rate (rate of convertation from margin currency to deposit one)

fixFlag.description: false = check only, true = check and fix
